verdict.rationale: Increase documents a dedicated Sandbox environment where every API and dashboard feature is available. It also offers Sandbox-only Simulation APIs for quickly testing events such as inbound wires, ACH, and 3DS flows, which lets developers and agents test without moving real money. This is a true separate sandbox environment, not merely a dry-run mode. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of how sandbox data and credentials are isolated from production, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the sandbox.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data

citations.quote: Every API and dashboard feature is available in Sandbox.
you can use special Simulation APIs, which are only available in Sandbox.
They can be helpful to quickly test events that might take several hours in the real world (like receiving a wire or ACH).
